digest.component_or_area: CLI confirmation system and code generation
propositions: Structural assertions on the shared confirmation reduce path must spy _confirm.emit/_confirm.emit_text to catch regressions that bypass the seam, parametrized over create/link/transition verbs with no-op variants.

The verb inventory table classifying mutations as no-op-capable versus always-writes must be curated in scripts/gen_cli_reference.py and rendered into generated docs/cli-reference.md with drift-gating that fails CI when a verb is added without classification.
The old-to-new confirmation-line mapping (pre-42cd70b889 to post-merge) must be recorded as golden data in the generated docs/cli-reference.md, sourced from the same curated data structure.
Confirmation formatters must require no store read on any path, verified by formatting in an empty directory with REBAR_ROOT unset.
